description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyDao class within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. The class provides data access methods for vacancy entities including retrieval, saving, deleting, and validation of vacancies, along with query methods for related attributes such as hiring managers and job titles. It interacts with a Doctrine ORM setup and extends a base DAO class.

classes.name: VacancyDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing Vacancy entities in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. Provides methods for querying, saving, deleting, and validating vacancies.

methods.name: getVacancies
methods.description: Returns a list of Vacancy objects based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacancyListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a Paginator object for Vacancy entities based on search parameters, handling sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getVacanciesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a Doctrine QueryBuilder with conditions based on the search filter parameters for retrieving vacancies.

methods.name: saveJobVacancy
methods.description: Persists a Vacancy entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getVacanciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of vacancies matching the specified search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyById
methods.description: Retrieves a Vacancy entity by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyIds
methods.description: Returns a list of vacancy IDs that exist from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteVacancies
methods.description: Deletes vacancies with specified IDs and returns whether the operation was successful.

methods.name: getHiringManagerEmpNumberList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unique hiring manager employee numbers from vacancies based on search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy IDs in the system.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns vacancy IDs associated with a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if an employee number corresponds to a current hiring manager with active vacancies.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancyList
methods.description: Returns all published vacancies, ordered by the last update time.

methods.name: isActiveJobTitle
methods.description: Checks if a job title ID corresponds to an active (not deleted) job title.

methods.name: isActiveHiringManger
methods.description: Checks if an employee number corresponds to an active employee with no termination record.
